reason: Bounded empirical study following engineering pilot; no claim of PPO optimality or convergence.

scene_generation.difficulty: prespecified sampled-motion surface-gap strata; not empirical controller success

training.ppo_config: same architecture, hyperparameters and reward as validated pilot

potential_tuning.grid: same 12 combinations as pilot, evaluated only on new validation
potential_tuning.selection: max full-trajectory success count, earliest prespecified grid index tie

model_selection: max validation success, min collision, max full completion, earliest checkpoint tie; trained checkpoints only; final optimizer update evaluated
test: 100 identical fixed scenes for tracker, tuned potential and each of 3 independently trained PPO seeds; no normalization updates or tuning

budget_estimate.note: This is a bounded roughly 40-minute training+validation study, not three million-step several-hour training; generation/test/report are separate. No convergence guarantee.
